maindhcp.description: Use odhcpd as the DHCPv4 server in place of dnsmasq. A read gives true only for `1` in the section named `odhcpd`, as dnsmasq.init reads it: dnsmasq stops serving DHCPv4 for a number above 0 there, while odhcpd is installed, unless odhcpd is disabled and dnsmasq has DHCPv6 support. odhcpd takes `1` and `true` from any `config odhcpd` section, and for any other value or no option keeps the value that it has, which is false after a start, because a reload does not reset it. In a section that is not named `odhcpd`, a read gives false, and a write of true stores `1` and still reads false.
